purpose: Separate framework-enforced controls from controls that only a repository or deployment administrator can apply and attest.

remaining_external_controls.control: Apply and audit the release branch-protection profile, including Repository secret scan, on GitHub.
Protect immutable release tags and the PyPI/npm deployment environments with non-self approval and trusted-publisher settings.
Keep the production edge, canonical host, TLS, HSTS, rate limits, and forwarded-header replacement aligned with the recorded production-edge evidence.
If the explicitly unsafe external-Pyodide escape hatch is used for a controlled demo, independently approve and pin every CDN/runtime byte; production should self-host instead.
High-trust deployments may configure an administrator-owned widget distribution/version/asset allowlist in addition to Pytincture's complete-wheel and asset hashes.
